priorities.message: Rendered pages with substantial body similarity detected
priorities.recommended_action: Use the owner-review consolidation ledger to decide which existing pages should be differentiated or, in a separately approved phase, consolidated. This build does not mutate live pages.

priorities.message: Query-intent overlap detected across rendered pages
priorities.recommended_action: Review intent-overlap clusters before approving new routes. Draft self-healing automatically differentiates new drafts; existing live pages remain owner-reviewed.
Rewrite openings around the specific horse transaction, document, dispute, or business issue; vary sentence length and reduce generic framing.
Review only if the page also lacks an answer, atom, routing block, or useful links. Never block approval on word count alone.

truth_boundary: Live provider data is authoritative only after a provider returns a successful external receipt. Grounded-search observations are not literal rank. Local quality measurements are regenerated during every build. No live legal-page repair occurs without owner approval.
